newsitem.title: JAPAN: JAPANESE NET BUYERS OF FOREIGN BONDS, STOCKS IN JUNE.
newsitem.headline: JAPANESE NET BUYERS OF FOREIGN BONDS, STOCKS IN JUNE.

text.p: Net purchases of foreign bonds by Japanese investors totalled 659.5 billion yen in June after net purchases of 1.9222 trillion yen a month earlier, the Ministry of Finance (MOF) said on Friday.
Japanese investors bought a net 605.7 billion yen worth of foreign stocks in June, against net purchases of 607 billion yen a month earlier, it said.
Bonds include beneficiary certificates but exclude bills. Details of Japanese and foreigners' investments in billions of yen, were as follows:
Foreign stocks: Net Foreign bonds: Net
Japanese stocks: Net Japanese bonds: Net
Figures are rounded and based on settlements.
